response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as status_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), status_above_avg AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.status_avg, oa.overall_avg, sa.status_avg - oa.overall_avg as above_average_diff FROM status_avg sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.status_avg > oa.overall_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying FROM status_above_avg) SELECT saa.rfistat, saa.status_avg, saa.above_average_diff, saa.status_avg - qm.mean_of_qualifying FROM status_above_avg saa CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm ORDER BY saa.rfistat
